items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: Because I had some good numbers for him.

ctx.x: I told him about a boy. To break some hands along. The wank he gon' pour the world. He gon' put salt in the back. Will you come back again? I hope so.

I'll probably be back again with Dr. Oster. I've been here before, wasn't I? I'm sorry. I'm sorry. We're not a bad man. Tell me where's Dr. Oster now? At LSU. In Baton Rouge. He was supposed to be gone in Pennsylvania State. He left me. No, he's still there. I talked to him yesterday on the phone. I talked to him again today, I hope. When I go to Baton Rouge. Because I had some good numbers for him. You couldn't make it on Sunday. Well, I think he can make it on Sunday. You want me to tell him that you can see it…
I'm wondering who was. One of those who make it to Lord of the Great. I see somebody gone, man.
